metadata.description: Standards bypass configuration for this branch

bypass.reason: clean_tracker is called during sync when limit=0 -- runtime path not statically reachable
format_result is public API surface called by CLI display layer

result.py is one dataclass and no function: it reads and writes no JSON and performs no operation to log. Its callers log the run it describes (build_metadata, append_changelog, the lanes' trail rows). Decision of @backup 2026-10-24.

_revoke_public_access returns True only on success; its two other False returns are the could-not-list and could-not-delete failures the docstring names. Checker reads failure guards as the success path. Decision of @backup, fleet green leg 5.

needs_upload answers True on a path it cannot relativise or stat, on purpose and named in its docstring: the upload that follows reports the real failure, where False would skip the file silently on every run. Decision of @backup, fleet green leg 5.

Same sites as the logged_fallback row: needs_upload answers True on a path it cannot relativise or stat, so the upload that follows reports the real failure; False would skip the file silently on every run. Decision of @backup, 2026-11-26.

One verb that fails to import must not take the others down: @daemon's nightly all @name --quiet still snapshots when share.py or a drive module is broken. The failure is logged at error and shown on stderr naming the module; its command then answers Unknown command, exit 1. Decision of @backup, 2026-11-26.

Drive is optional and off by default: local snapshots must import and run without the Google libraries. GOOGLE_API_AVAILABLE=False is never read as installed; authenticate refuses with DriveError naming GOOGLE_PACKAGES, so no Drive run proceeds without them. Decision of @backup, 2026-11-26.

Drive is optional and off by default: local snapshots must import and run without the Google libraries. MEDIA_UPLOAD_AVAILABLE=False is never read as installed; upload_single_file raises DriveError naming GOOGLE_PACKAGES, logged at warning and trailed, and writes no tracker entry. Decision of @backup, 2026-11-26.
